## Summary

Eisenberg announces he runs a "mini alpha capture program" — his gloss: "the fancy pod terminology for *people give me ideas and get paid when they work out*." Claims paid out **mid 7 figures** across several people so far. Invitation: DMs open for anyone with alpha. Preferences: **short or medium term, somewhat scalable, minimum 100k PnL potential**; can deploy **7–8 figures** into the right opportunity; open to ideas requiring code or operational complexity. Payments sized by edge, estimated risks, consistency.

## Why it matters

- A live, stated-terms snapshot of the **alpha-capture / pod-idea-sourcing market** the vault has only seen from the research side: [[2026-10-28-margincall4-overfitting-validation-dsr-pbo-walkforward]] (how fragile most edges are once validated honestly) and [[2026-11-04-zenomtrader-substack-alpha-replication]] (the industrial hunt for other people's edges). This is the demand side: someone with 7–8 figures explicitly shopping for exactly the kind of short/medium-term edges those notes keep stress-testing. Pairs naturally with [[2026-10-31-futako1013-17-edge-index-forward-first]] — idea sourcing as a market with posted bid terms.
- **Who's making the offer matters as much as the terms.** Avi Eisenberg is the Mango Markets manipulator (2022 conviction) — the "applied game theorist" self-description is a wink at that history. He served his sentence and is visibly active again (posting through Oct–Nov 2026). Counterparty risk is the headline feature of any DM here: this is an adversarial-game-theory specialist soliciting proprietary edges. See skepticism gates.
- **Skepticism gates:** every number is self-reported and unfalsifiable from the tweet — "mid 7 figures paid out", "7–8 figures deployable", "minimum 100k PnL". No program terms, no payout structure, no verification of anything. The author's history makes outright operational risk non-trivial; sharing an edge over DM with a convicted manipulator is the due-diligence bar in its own right. Also: the invitation is broad (public, DMs open) — the economics of broad public idea-sourcing skew toward adverse selection; the ideas that arrive unsolicited are disproportionately the ones that didn't work for their owners.
- Reference only — no task. The user doesn't run pod-style strategies or share live edges externally; captured as market context on how this corner of the industry sources alpha, not as an opportunity.
